# starrocks_index (Data Source)

Reads metadata for a StarRocks secondary index. Identifies the index by database, table, and index name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "starrocks_index" "example" {
  database = "my_database"
  table    = "my_table"
  name     = "idx_user_id"
}

output "index_type" {
  value = data.starrocks_index.example.type
}

output "index_column" {
  value = data.starrocks_index.example.column
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database` (String) The database that contains the table.
- `name` (String) The index name.
- `table` (String) The table the index belongs to.

### Read-Only

- `column` (String) The column the index is defined on.
- `comment` (String) Index comment.
- `type` (String) The index type (e.g. `BITMAP`, `NGRAMBF`).
